restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: This is the uploaded Vingcard Novel brochure with printed document version 04/2025.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Use this edition as the source; do not infer current product availability, current certification status, an exact publication day or a separate copyright year.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: Native extraction includes a covered cover-page folio and repeated running footers on several interior pages.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Cite physical PDF pages; do not turn hidden or repeated running text into content records or duplicate pages.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: The contents entries are distributed across the introductory spread, not in simple raw-text reading order.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Preserve the five actual destination pages 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14 when indexing; these are source topics, not NSP section assignments.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: Competitor hardware, materials, certifications, protocols and physical-performance claims are mixed with benefits and presentation ideas.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: In S02 retain source evidence with attribution as needed; exclude competitor models, hardware specifications and certificates from the S03 NSP feature bank. Hardware product identity is retained only as source identity.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: Quantitative environmental, durability, battery-life and temperature statements belong to this competitor product and include comparison or usage context.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Later extraction must keep the original units, comparison basis and conditions. These figures are not NSP performance evidence or generic verified engineering rules.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: Mobile Access, Vostio Access Management, Apple Wallet and online event alarms appear alongside product-specific conditions.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Software and guest-experience ideas may be researched with exact wording and page references. Preserve the software license condition on page 11 and the requires Online option condition on page 15. Do not infer equivalent NSP support or automatic GRMS/PMS/IPTV integration.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: The overview visibly prints ANS BHMA while later security pages use ANSI BHMA and specific standard identifiers.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Do not silently normalize the source wording in S02; record the local wording and flag any editorial correction separately. No certification is attributed to NSP.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: A photo-led slogan page, four installation photographs, a phone interface image and product cutaway contain presentation ideas.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: S04 may inspect these as visual references. Do not create hardware or software capabilities merely from appearance; do not treat this S01 inventory as completed image extraction.

restrictions_and_audit_flags.issue: The printed note says specifications may change and brochure image colors may differ from actual colors.
restrictions_and_audit_flags.control: Keep source limitations; competitor artwork is internal research material and requires original or separately authorized replacement for final NSP publication.

stage_contract.S04: Review distinct presentation styles and representative images with provenance and research-only rights.
stage_contract.S05: Propose mappings using the current SECTIONS_STRUCTURE.json and stable identifiers; retain source type separately and do not create new system chapters.
stage_contract.S06: Audit quotes, translations, page references, image provenance, mapping and claim boundaries.
